newsitem.title: USA: EDS apparent winner of Energy Dept contract.
newsitem.headline: EDS apparent winner of Energy Dept contract.

text.p: Electronic Data Systems Inc and its partners are the apparent winners of a $600 million contract to provide telecommunications integration services to the U.S. Energy Department, the company said on Friday.

The company said the award would be confirmed after a routine check to determine whether EDS and its subcontractors met foreign-ownership rules. Its partners in the project include GTE Corp, Lucent Technologies Inc and Macfadden & Associates Inc.
EDS said its portion of the contract would be worth $350 million.
The five-year contract represents the first effort by a federal agency to out-source all of its communications and networking needs, EDS said.
EDS shares were off 1/2 at 39-1/4 late Friday afternoon.
